scope: Personal dictionary forgetting versus independent next-word history
findings: Delete button delegates only to session.forgetPersonal, which updates engine/fallback personal dictionaries and persists.
Independent TypingHistory is not cleared by that action; nextWordPredictions reads it when predictNext is enabled.
Core probe learns literal, observes same surface in PersonalHistory, forgets personal, and retains history next-word result across JSON roundtrip.
classification: Cross-store deletion scope limitation; not spontaneous personal-dictionary re-admission. UI section is personal dictionary, so whether delete should suppress all sources is a product behavior decision.
limits: Independent history observation supplied directly, source inspection connects app flow. Not simulator button test.
predictNext must be enabled; recall controls were empty in these probes.
